title: High-iodine-loading quasi-solid-state zinc–iodine batteries enabled by a continuous ion-transport network
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,4730-4739
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01170A, Paper
Xin Yang, Minghao Xie, Zhijie Yan, Hang Ruan, Chunpeng Yang, Zaiping Guo, Zi-Jian Zheng
A quasi-solid-state Zn–I2 battery, which incorporates a 3D continuous ion-transport network through a bacterial cellulose-integrated thick cathode design, enables high iodine loading of 39.3 mg cm−2 and efficient zinc ion conduction.
